categories.main_business_segments: Winning Health Technology Group primarily operates in the medical and health information technology sector, offering integrated solutions including smart hospital systems, regional health platforms, grassroots health, public health, medical insurance, and health services. The company also develops internet healthcare services and digital health applications under its '1+X' strategy, with '1' representing the WiNEX product series and 'X' representing various digital health scenarios such as internet hospitals and medical insurance linkage.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced AI technologies, including its proprietary medical vertical large model WiNGPT and AI-powered medical assistant WiNEX Copilot, integrated into its WiNEX product line. It employs a unified middle-platform architecture, digital knowledge graphs, intelligent data governance engines, and AI model training frameworks. The company also emphasizes cloud-native architecture, microservices, low-code/no-code development platforms, and deep integration with domestic IT ecosystems for secure, scalable, and efficient healthcare IT solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Winning Health serves primarily domestic public hospitals, health management departments, and regional healthcare institutions across China. Its customer base includes over 6,000 medical institutions, including more than 400 tertiary hospitals, covering 32 provinces and municipalities. The company also targets internet healthcare users and medical insurance entities, expanding into commercial insurance and digital health service markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across mainland China, with significant revenue contributions from Shanghai, other East China regions, North China, Central China, and South China. It has begun international expansion with projects in Macau and Southeast Asia. Its subsidiaries and operations span multiple provinces including Jiangsu, Shanxi, Beijing, Chongqing, Heilongjiang, Guangdong, Ningxia, and others.
categories.supply_chain_position: Winning Health operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the healthcare IT supply chain, focusing on software development, system integration, and service provision to healthcare institutions and insurance entities. It provides end-to-end digital healthcare solutions, including hardware sales, software licensing, and ongoing technical support and cloud services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus centers on AI-driven innovation, particularly the development and application of medical vertical large models and intelligent assistants to enhance clinical and operational efficiency. It continues to invest heavily in R&D, with over 20% of revenue allocated to research, focusing on next-generation smart hospital products, AI integration, cloud readiness, and digital health ecosystem expansion. The '1+X' strategy integrates AI capabilities deeply into healthcare digital transformation.
categories.revenue_model: Winning Health generates revenue through multiple streams including software and hardware sales, information system project contracts, and long-term technical support and maintenance service contracts. It also earns income from internet healthcare services and digital health applications, including cloud services and medical insurance linkage. Revenue is recognized based on contract fulfillment and service delivery milestones.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading market position in China’s hospital core system market with a 13.4% share, ranking first for four consecutive years (2020-2023). It competes with other domestic and international healthcare IT providers in software, AI applications, and digital health services. Its competitive advantages include comprehensive product lines, strong R&D capabilities, extensive customer coverage, and early adoption of AI technologies in healthcare.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Winning Health reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.78 billion, a 12.05% decrease year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 87.9 million, down 75.45%. Despite revenue decline due to delayed client demand and product upgrades, the company improved cash flow from operations by 120.53%. Total assets reached RMB 8.76 billion, with net assets of RMB 5.96 billion, reflecting a stable financial scale with ongoing investment in innovation and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Winning Health emphasizes its integrated, AI-empowered healthcare IT solutions that enhance clinical efficiency, hospital management, and patient experience. Its proprietary AI large model WiNGPT and intelligent assistant WiNEX Copilot provide differentiated capabilities in medical data analysis and workflow automation. The company’s extensive product ecosystem, deep domestic market penetration, and commitment to digital transformation position it as a trusted partner for healthcare institutions seeking smart, scalable, and secure digital health solutions.
